requirements.text: Patients should be able to book, cancel, or reschedule appointments online through a user-friendly dashboard.
Patients should have a straightforward process to request repeat prescriptions, with clear indications of medication eligibility and automated confirmations.
Patients should be able to access test results securely, with results only available after clinician authorization and clear explanations provided for the results.
The portal should prioritize urgent patient requests, allowing them to indicate urgency when booking appointments and flagging those requests for immediate attention.
The portal must integrate seamlessly with existing practice management software, ensuring real-time synchronization of data.
The system must maintain compliance with GDPR for data security.
The patient portal should provide automated confirmation messages for appointment changes and prescription requests.
The process for booking, canceling, and rescheduling appointments must be straightforward and user-friendly.
Patients should receive notifications when their test results are ready to view.
The integration should not require a full data migration or extensive retraining for staff.
